Daniel (Danik) Peper, son of Yulia and Vladislav, was born on 26 Adar I 5760 (2 March 2000) and grew up in Be'er Sheva.

On 25 March 2019 he enlisted in the reserves and served in the Armored Corps.

Staff Sergeant First Class Daniel (Danik) Peper fell during his service in the course of the war on 17 Menachem Av 5786 (31 July 2026). He was twenty-six years old when he fell. He was laid to rest in the military cemetery in Be'er Sheva. He is survived by his parents and siblings.
